META_TITLE: Budgeting for Expats & Multi-Currency Life — FincWin
META_DESCRIPTION: Manage money across currencies and countries: track every currency, budget without a local bank link, and keep working offline. Free to start, private.
OG_DESCRIPTION: Expat or multi-currency? FincWin tracks every currency, needs no local bank link, and works fully offline.
PERSONA_SUBHEAD: Income here, rent there, savings somewhere else — FincWin tracks it all in any currency, with no local bank link required.
SITUATION_HEADLINE: Most budget apps assume one country and one currency
SITUATION_BODY:
Move abroad or earn across borders and the usual apps break: they want a local bank, a single currency, and a home address that matches.

FincWin makes none of those assumptions. Add accounts in any currency, budget without linking a bank, and keep working even on patchy travel connections.
HOW_IT_HELPS:
• →Full multi-currency: track balances and budgets in any currency.
  • →No local bank required: add transactions manually or by CSV.
  • →Works offline: a full PWA that keeps going on the move.
  • →Net worth across borders: see your whole position in one view.
